detail.longDescription: To prove a UI fix worked, coding agents that couldn't attach screenshots via GitHub's CLI made public repos to host them. Glow Labs found 13,000+ internal images from 300+ orgs, treasury consoles included. 93% of cases used an employee's personal account. No attacker involved: the approved path lacked one capability, so the agent made its own. https://www. glow.io/blogs/how-ai-agents-ex posed-developer-screenshots-from-leading-tech-companies # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # GitHub
